knowledge.name: Unit 1 Look and see
Look and see 看与见的基本动词
knowledge.explanation: look 强调「看」的动作，see 强调「看见」的结果。

knowledge.name: Look and see 公园里的常见事物
knowledge.explanation: tree, flower, bird, kite 等词用来描述公园。

knowledge.name: Look and see 冠词 a / an 的选择
knowledge.explanation: 元音音素开头的词前用 an，其余用 a。

knowledge.name: Look and see 数量表达 one / two
knowledge.explanation: 数量大于一时名词要用复数形式。

knowledge.name: Unit 2 Listen and hear
Listen and hear 听与听见
knowledge.explanation: listen 强调听得动作，常与 to 连用；hear 强调听见的结果。

knowledge.name: Listen and hear 常见声音词汇
knowledge.explanation: sing, bark, ring, cry 等动词表示不同声音。

knowledge.name: Listen and hear 教室里的指令句
knowledge.explanation: Listen carefully. Open your book. 是常见的课堂指令。

knowledge.name: Listen and hear 声音大小与形容词
knowledge.explanation: loud / quiet 用来描述声音的大小。

knowledge.name: Unit 3 Taste and smell
Taste and smell 两个感官动词
knowledge.explanation: taste 尝味道，smell 闻气味，都与食物相关。

knowledge.name: Taste and smell 味道形容词
knowledge.explanation: sweet, sour, salty, hot 描述不同的味道。

knowledge.name: Taste and smell 食物名词
knowledge.explanation: soup, candy, cake, fruit 等是常见食物名词。

knowledge.name: Taste and smell 感官句型 It tastes/smells …
knowledge.explanation: It tastes / smells + 形容词 描述食物给人的感觉。

knowledge.name: Unit 4 Toys I like
Toys I like 玩具词汇
knowledge.explanation: ball, doll, car, kite, robot 是常见玩具词。

knowledge.name: Toys I like 表达喜好 I like …
knowledge.explanation: I like + 名词，表示喜欢某物；不喜欢说 I don't like。

knowledge.name: Toys I like 询问他人喜好 Do you like …?
knowledge.explanation: Do you like …? 用 Yes, I do. / No, I don't. 回答。

knowledge.name: Toys I like 颜色与玩具搭配
knowledge.explanation: 颜色词放在名词前，如 a blue ball。

knowledge.name: Unit 5 Food I like
Food I like 食物词汇与三餐
knowledge.explanation: breakfast, lunch, dinner 表示三餐；rice, noodles, egg 是常见食物。

knowledge.name: Food I like some / a 的用法
knowledge.explanation: 不可数名词前用 some，可数单数前用 a / an。

knowledge.name: Food I like 喜欢与不喜欢的表达
knowledge.explanation: I like / I don't like 用于表达对食物的喜好。

knowledge.name: Food I like 问句 What do you like?
knowledge.explanation: What do you like? 回答用 I like …。

knowledge.name: Unit 6 Drinks I like
Drinks I like 饮料词汇
knowledge.explanation: water, milk, juice, tea 是常见饮料词。

knowledge.name: Drinks I like 不可数名词与量
knowledge.explanation: 饮料多不可数，用 some / a glass of 表示数量。

knowledge.name: Drinks I like 礼貌请求 Can I have …?
knowledge.explanation: Can I have …, please? 是礼貌索要的说法。

knowledge.name: Drinks I like 冷热与口味描述
knowledge.explanation: hot / cold / sweet 描述饮料。

knowledge.name: Unit 7 Seasons
Seasons 四季名称
knowledge.explanation: spring, summer, autumn, winter 是四季。

knowledge.name: Seasons 季节与天气搭配
knowledge.explanation: 不同季节有典型天气：春天温暖、夏天炎热、秋天凉爽、冬天寒冷。

knowledge.name: Seasons 季节活动 I can … in …
knowledge.explanation: 用 I can … in spring/summer 说明季节里能做的事。

knowledge.name: Seasons 季节与服装
knowledge.explanation: 不同季节穿不同衣服，coat / T-shirt / sweater 等词配合使用。

knowledge.name: Unit 8 Weather
Weather 天气词汇
knowledge.explanation: sunny, rainy, windy, cloudy, snowy 描述天气。

knowledge.name: Weather 询问天气 How's the weather?
knowledge.explanation: How's the weather? 回答 It is + 天气形容词。

knowledge.name: Weather 天气与活动选择
knowledge.explanation: 天气决定活动：雨天带伞、晴天外出。

knowledge.name: Weather 天气与衣物
knowledge.explanation: 冷天加衣、热天减衣，raincoat / boots 应对雨天。

knowledge.name: Unit 9 Clothes
Clothes 衣物词汇
knowledge.explanation: shirt, skirt, dress, shoes, socks 是常见衣物词。

knowledge.name: Clothes 单复数与 a pair of
knowledge.explanation: 成双的衣物用 a pair of；复数名词配 are。

knowledge.name: Clothes 穿着动词 wear / put on
knowledge.explanation: wear 表示穿着状态，put on 表示穿上的动作。

knowledge.name: Clothes 询问与赞美
knowledge.explanation: What are you wearing? / It looks nice. 是常见交流句。

knowledge.name: Unit 10 Activities
Activities 常见活动词汇
knowledge.explanation: run, jump, swim, sing, dance, draw 是常见活动动词。

knowledge.name: Activities can 表达能力
knowledge.explanation: can + 动词原形 表示会做某事，否定用 can't。

knowledge.name: Activities 询问能力 Can you …?
knowledge.explanation: Can you …? 回答 Yes, I can. / No, I can't.

knowledge.name: Activities 活动与地点搭配
knowledge.explanation: 活动发生地点要合理，如 swim in the pool。

knowledge.name: Unit 11 New Year's Day
New Year's Day 节日与日期表达
knowledge.explanation: New Year's Day 是新年，Happy New Year 是常用祝福。

knowledge.name: New Year's Day 新年活动与礼物
knowledge.explanation: gift, card, party, fireworks 是新年相关词。

knowledge.name: New Year's Day 祝福语与祝愿句型
knowledge.explanation: I wish you … / Happy New Year to you 表达祝愿。

knowledge.name: New Year's Day 复数的礼物与数量
knowledge.explanation: 多个礼物用复数 gifts，配数词。

knowledge.name: Unit 12 A boy and a wolf
A boy and a wolf 故事情节理解
knowledge.parent: Unit 12 A boy and a wolf
knowledge.explanation: 故事讲男孩喊狼来了骗人，最后没人相信他。

knowledge.name: A boy and a wolf 故事的教训
knowledge.parent: Unit 12 A boy and a wolf
knowledge.explanation: 撒谎会失去别人的信任，这是故事的寓意。

knowledge.name: A boy and a wolf 过去时态的初步感知
knowledge.parent: Unit 12 A boy and a wolf
knowledge.explanation: 故事里的事已发生，动词常用过去式，如 shouted, ran。

knowledge.name: A boy and a wolf 角色与对话朗读
knowledge.parent: Unit 12 A boy and a wolf
knowledge.explanation: 故事中有男孩、农民、狼等角色，对话要读出语气。
